title: Hard Hat Economics: Where construction is growing in 2026 (besides data centers)
summary: Data centers get the headlines, but they’re not the whole story. Tariffs and fuel costs are keeping construction prices elevated, while parts of manufacturing construction are bouncing back. Here’s where the industry is growing in 2026.
